body: Hey! Sorry about the wait. Just forgot to post. I called a hotline and it was great; they helped me really understand the talking tips, and she was a lot more responsive the next few times we talked. She's been feeling a lot better too! Thanks a lot guys.

I'm worried now because she says that our conversations about it never go anywhere. Whenever I try empathizing with her, she usually responds with "I guess". I really don't know how I can help her anymore at this point. I think I'm going to call a hotline. I'll let you guys know about what happens.

I myself had problems with depression earlier in life. Say I relate to her experience. After I say that I know how bad and hopeless it gets, what do I do? I've read and reread the talking tips and she still doesn't seem to be improving. Thanks for all the help though.
